data.change_summary: No additional fixes were applied in this stage. The prior review approved the per-tick N/C/O2 budget ledger implementation without actionable amendments, so the code remains as produced in the implement stage.
outstanding_risks: Canonical live-biomass C/N totals still depend on shared stoichiometric helper assumptions in `types/budget.rs`; if future phases add new explicit element-bearing fields or refine biomass composition, those helpers and tests must be updated together.

The closed-system conservation checks use a quiescent no-growth scenario. Richer gameplay states may still expose pre-existing stoichiometry gaps in systems that do not yet move every element explicitly, but the new ledger makes those imbalances inspectable.
No compile-time coverage guard exists for newly added element-bearing state fields; helper completeness still relies on the canonical helper tests being kept in sync with state evolution.
